entries.title: Bronchus question corrected
entries.summary: The intrapulmonary-versus-extrapulmonary bronchus question now grades C: a distinct muscularis mucosae, as stated on course slide 15. Both have respiratory epithelium. The incorrect A bank key and older rewritten duplicate have been reconciled into one clarified question.
